name: Yandere Ghost
source:
Chihiro's kicked the bucket after a fatal hit and run. The next thing you know, she's a ghost with a mission - win the heart of her classmate Franberry, no matter what she thinks. With the help of her new mediumship practicing friend Katami, will Chihiro take Franberry's love all for herself?

[From [url=https://corinna-vndev.itch.io/yandere-ghost]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
千寻在一场致命的肇事逃逸车祸中不幸一命呜呼。回过神来，她已经变成了一只肩负执念使命的幽灵——无论同班同学弗兰贝莉本人怎么想，她都誓要夺得对方的芳心！在修习通灵术的新朋友形见的协助下，千寻能否将弗兰贝莉的爱彻底独占？

[摘自[url=https://corinna-vndev.itch.io/yandere-ghost]itch.io[/url]]
